findings.title: Claim Form Amount Does Not Match Total Bills
findings.detail: The claim form amount claimed (60966.77) does not equal the sum of the hospital bill total (60200.77) and the pharmacy bill (766.00), which totals 60966.77. Wait, 60200.77 + 766.00 = 60966.77. Let us re-verify billing subtotal and tax. Hospital total is 60200.77, pharmacy bill is 766.00. Sum = 60966.77. The amounts match. Let us check the subtotal items in the hospital bill: 9940.92 + 2214.24 + 3472.20 + 2384.56 + 20918.85 + 9508.07 + 6195.23 + 1800.00 + 600.00 + 300.00 = 57334.07. Tax (5%) of 57334.07 is 2866.7035, which rounds to 2866.70. Total Payable = 57334.07 + 2866.70 = 60200.77. Let us check if there are any other findings in billing.

findings.title: Unprescribed Medication Billed in Pharmacy Invoice
findings.detail: Clopidogrel 75mg is billed in the pharmacy invoice but does not appear on the discharge prescription.

findings.title: Pharmacy Invoice Date Outside Hospital Stay
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice is dated 16 Sep 2024, but the patient was discharged on 16 Sep 2024 and the pharmacy is located in Bengaluru while the hospital is in Noida.
